item.title: No, George Washington didn't have wooden teeth. Yes, he led the Siege of Boston
item.description: BOSTON (AP) — More than a decade before he became the country's first president, George Washington was leading a critical campaign in the early days of the American Revolution. item.title: Cat food recall expanded over risk of serious illness
item.description: A recall of potentially harmful cat food has been expanded to include two additional lots of products, affecting 20 states, according to a Food and Drug Administration (FDA) announcement Friday.

item.title: Arkansas State Police investigating Lavaca bank robbery
item.description: Arkansas State Police says an investigation into a Thursday afternoon bank robbery in Lavaca is underway.

item.title: Louisiana bill would abolish Department of Children and Family Services, shift duties to other agencies
item.description: A Louisiana lawmaker proposes abolishing the Louisiana Department of Children and Family Services (DCFS) in a newly filed bill for the legislative session.

item.title: Local woman honored for aiding Barksdale military families

item.title: US stocks sink and oil prices rise as worries about AI, inflation and possible war hit Wall Street
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — U.S. stocks sank Friday as Wall Street kept punishing companies that could become losers in the artificial-intelligence revolution. A surprisingly discouraging update on inflation also hurt the market, while oil prices climbed with worries about tensions between the United States and Iran.
